# kentik-synthetics_agent (Resource)

Manages an existing synthetic monitoring agent. Agents cannot be created through the Kentik API: they register themselves when installed. This resource adopts an existing agent (by `agent_id`, or with `terraform import`) and manages the attributes that the UpdateAgent API call accepts: `alias`, `site_id`, `site_name`, `labels`, `status` (set `AGENT_STATUS_OK` to authorize a waiting private agent), `family` and location. Attributes that are not configured are left unchanged. Global (Kentik-managed) agents are read-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Adopt an existing private agent (agents register themselves when installed; they cannot be created
# through the API), authorize it and manage its alias, site and labels.
resource "kentik-synthetics_agent" "office" {
  agent_id = "1717"
  status   = "AGENT_STATUS_OK" # authorize the waiting agent
  alias    = "office-ny-1"
  site_id  = "42"
  labels   = ["office", "us-east"]

  # Default false: `terraform destroy` only forgets the agent. Set to true to delete it from Kentik.
  delete_on_destroy = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) ID of an existing agent to manage. The agent must already be registered with Kentik.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) User selected descriptive name of the agent.
- `city` (String) City where the agent is located.
- `country` (String) Country of agent's location.
- `delete_on_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the agent from Kentik when the resource is destroyed. Default `false`: destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state. A deleted agent is removed from all tests and has to be re-registered (re-installed) to come back.
- `family` (String) IP address family supported by the agent. Valid values: `IP_FAMILY_V4`, `IP_FAMILY_V6`, `IP_FAMILY_DUAL`.
- `labels` (Set of String) List of names of labels associated with the agent.
- `lat` (Number) Latitude of agent's location (signed decimal degrees).
- `long` (Number) Longitude of agent's location (signed decimal degrees).
- `region` (String) Geographical region of agent's location.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the site hosting the agent (if configured in Kentik).
- `site_name` (String) Name of the site where agent is located.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the agent. Set `AGENT_STATUS_OK` to authorize a private agent that is waiting (`AGENT_STATUS_WAIT`).

### Read-Only

- `agent_impl` (String) Agent implementation: `IMPLEMENT_TYPE_RUST` (network agent), `IMPLEMENT_TYPE_NODE` (app agent with Chromium) or `IMPLEMENT_TYPE_NETWORK` (app agent without Chromium).
- `asn` (Number) ASN of the AS owning agent's public address.
- `cloud_provider` (String) Cloud provider (if any) hosting the agent.
- `cloud_region` (String) Cloud region (if any) hosting the agent.
- `cloud_vpc` (String, Deprecated) **Deprecated.** Not provided by synthetics API v202309; always empty.
- `id` (String) ID of the agent.
- `ip` (String) Public IP address of the agent (auto-detected).
- `last_authed` (String) Timestamp of the last authorization.
- `local_ip` (String) Internal IP address of the agent.
- `metadata` (List of Object) Additional information about agent's configuration and run-time state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `name` (String, Deprecated) **Deprecated.** Use `site_name` instead (same value).
- `os` (String) OS version of server/VM hosting the agent.
- `test_ids` (List of String) IDs of user's test running on the agent.
- `type` (String) Type of agent (global | private).
- `version` (String) Software version of the agent.

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Read-Only:

- `private_ipv4_addresses` (List of String)
- `private_ipv6_addresses` (List of String)
- `public_ipv4_addresses` (List of String)
- `public_ipv6_addresses` (List of String)
- `static_ipv4` (Boolean)
- `static_ipv6` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Agents are imported by agent ID.
terraform import kentik-synthetics_agent.office 1717
```
